description: Screen a product catalog for Korean import restrictions in one call. Submit up to 100 HS codes and get back what is restricted, with the statute, the approving agencies and the certificate required for each. Restricted codes come first, then codes that could not be checked, then clear ones. Invalid codes are listed in summary.invalid_hs and not counted. Use before opening a Korea shipping lane or listing a catalog for Korean buyers. Fact lookup only — not a legal customs determination.
name: check_korea_import_requirements_batch
title: Screen a product catalog for Korean import restrictions
